description: This Java class 'TaskDefinition' represents metadata for a schedulable task in the OpenMRS system. It includes properties for task scheduling (start time, interval, flags), task identification (class name, ID), and lifecycle management (start, stop, properties). It likely participates in a larger scheduling framework within OpenMRS.

classes.name: TaskDefinition
classes.description: Represents a schedulable task's metadata, including scheduling details, task class, properties, and lifecycle flags.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the task.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the task.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the map of properties associated with the task.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the map of properties for the task.

methods.name: getTaskClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the task implementation.

methods.name: setTaskClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the task implementation.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time for the task.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the scheduled start time for the task.

methods.name: getLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the last execution timestamp of the task.

methods.name: setLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Sets the last execution timestamp.

methods.name: getRepeatInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval in seconds for task repetition.

methods.name: setRepeatInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval in seconds for task repetition.

methods.name: getStartTimePattern
methods.description: Returns the date pattern used for start time formatting.

methods.name: setStartTimePattern
methods.description: Sets the date pattern used for start time formatting.

methods.name: getStartOnStartup
methods.description: Indicates whether the task should start on system startup.

methods.name: setStartOnStartup
methods.description: Sets whether the task should start on system startup.

methods.name: getStarted
methods.description: Indicates whether the task has been started.

methods.name: setStarted
methods.description: Sets the started flag for the task.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value by key.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property key-value pair.

methods.name: getNextExecutionTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next scheduled execution time.

methods.name: getSecondsUntilNextExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds until the next execution.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the task definition.

methods.name: getTaskInstance
methods.description: Returns the runnable task instance, if any.

methods.name: setTaskInstance
methods.description: Associates a runnable task instance with this definition.
